summary: Claude invoked hyperpowers:brainstorming, explicitly classified the "move API endpoint config" brief as ARCHITECTURAL, ran a question sequence, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-settings-module-design.md, presented it for approval with no implementation code written, and moved to writing-plans only after I said "looks good, go ahead".
reasoning: All five acceptance criteria are supported by direct evidence from the screen, the workdir filesystem, and the session JSONL log. The router escalated correctly on this adversarial brief.

observations.description: Launch showed the theme picker, security notes, folder-trust, and bypass-permissions dialogs despite the HOWTO stating dialog-bypass state was seeded; tester had to click through four prompts.

The agent auto-created a .gitignore covering docs/hyperpowers and docs/superpowers citing a 'standing rule', so the spec is untracked/uncommitted — acceptance wording mentions a 'committed spec file', which this technically is not.
Design narrative streamed above the interactive question widget, so long prose scrolled off-screen before options appeared; hard to read the full rationale in a 40-row pane.
Spec header says 'Status: approved design' even though it was written before the human approved it.

criteria.evidence: Session log contains {"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}} (grep of the .jsonl rollout); screen later showed Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans) only after approval.

criteria.criterion: Classified ARCHITECTURAL and wrote spec to docs/*/specs/ before presenting design
criteria.evidence: Assistant text in log: "**Classification: architectural, not bounded.** I want to flag why, since the change sounds like a one-line move." File on disk: docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-settings-module-design.md (6994 bytes, header '# Settings Module Design ... Status: approved design, not yet implemented').

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before any implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-settings-module-design.md ... Please review the spec and tell me if you want changes. ... I won't write any code before that." git status --short in workdir at that moment showed only '?? .gitignore' — no source edits.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: Log quote explicitly says "architectural, not bounded"; spec file exists on disk as listed above.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / probe plan
criteria.evidence: No spike classification in log; only occurrence of 'spike' is in the skill's own instruction text (grep -c 'spike' returned 1 line, the skill doc). Agent followed spec-doc path instead.
